worked_trace.heading: Worked ternary compilation: three roles, one qualified candidate
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Typed roles, denominator completeness, invalidation, and fallback are coherent in the finite model; representational value and natural-task advantage remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The simpler baseline stores pairwise edges and drops the joint condition. The candidate compiler must first show that matched pairwise, sequence, retrieval, tool, and ordinary-model rescues fail on held-out structure.
readable_claim: Higher-order structure earns a place only when typed joint roles solve a held-out relation that strong lower-order representations cannot solve as well.
normative_rule: Preserve every candidate and lower-order rescue in the denominator, address roles by identity rather than position, and compile on the slow path. Missing roles, hidden candidates, unmatched budgets, active descendants, or failed held-out qualification force fallback.

formal_binding.anchor: slow-path relational-dimension compiler over stable lower-arity primitives
